hooks.command: input="$(cat)"; if printf '%s' "$input" | /usr/bin/grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'; then exit 0; fi; if [ -z "${ATCT_ROLE:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -x "${ATCT_BIN:-}" ] || [ -z "${ATCT_PROJECT_ID:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"ATCT stop-check failed: monitor scope unavailable"}'; exit 0; fi; output="$("$ATCT_BIN" stop-check --role "$ATCT_ROLE" --project "$ATCT_PROJECT_ID" --goal "${ATCT_GOAL_ID:-}" --task "${ATCT_TASK_ID:-}" 2>/dev/null)" || { printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"ATCT stop-check failed: command unavailable"}'; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$output"
